blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has selected Supreme Court Associate Justice Rodil V. Zalameda to be the Supreme Court’s next chief justice. Presidential Communications Office Secretary Lino Cayetano made the announcement on Thursday, saying Zalameda will succeed Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, who is set to retire on Nov. 6. “Justice Zalameda brings more than three decades of distinguished service to our justice system,” said Cayetano at a Palace briefing. “From his early years as a court official and public prosecutor to his service in the Court of Appeals and ultimately the Supreme Court, he has devoted his professional life to […]...
